about: Innisfail is a town in central Alberta on Highway 2 between Calgary and Red Deer, in parkland farming country. A compact downtown, agricultural-service role, and nearby historic village museum define this prairie highway town. About 8,000 people live in Innisfail.
seoSummary: Central Alberta Highway 2 town between Calgary and Red Deer—parkland agricultural service centre.
knownFor: Highway 2 town between Calgary and Red Deer
